description: This file is a Perl script for manipulating NSLU2 firmware images, including functions for parsing, creating, editing, and writing firmware partitions, as well as command-line options for packaging and unpacking firmware images.

methods.name: padBytes
methods.description: Pads the given data to a specified total length with 0xFF bytes to match flash erase value.

methods.name: paddedSize
methods.description: Calculates the next multiple of block_size greater than or equal to given data length.

methods.name: numBlocks
methods.description: Calculates number of block_size blocks required to hold the given data length.

methods.name: createPartitionEntry
methods.description: Creates a binary partition entry with name, address, size, and optional skip regions.

methods.name: parsePartitionEntry
methods.description: Parses a binary partition entry into readable components such as name, address, size, and skips.

methods.name: findPartitionTable
methods.description: Locates and extracts the partition table from firmware data based on 'RedBoot' signature.

methods.name: parsePartitionTable
methods.description: Parses the extracted partition table into an array of partition info structures.

methods.name: jffs2Block
methods.description: Creates a blank JFFS2 block.

methods.name: writeOut
methods.description: Writes data to a specified filename.

methods.name: trailerData
methods.description: Generates binary data for a trailer based on product and version info.

methods.name: printRedbootTrailer
methods.description: Prints parsed information from RedBoot trailer data.

methods.name: removeOptionalLoader
methods.description: Removes the Loader partition from the partition list and adjusts Kernel and Ramdisk offsets.

methods.name: spliceFirmwarePartitions
methods.description: Identifies and updates partition info based on the firmware's partition table.

methods.name: checkPartitionTable
methods.description: Sanity checks a partition table data structure for validity.

methods.name: printPartitions
methods.description: Displays partition information in a human-readable format.

methods.name: defaultPartitions
methods.description: Returns a default set of partition definitions for a firmware image.

methods.name: readInFirmware
methods.description: Reads firmware image from file and populates partition data structures.

methods.name: writeOutFirmwareParts
methods.description: Writes in-memory partition data to respective files.

methods.name: readInFirmwareParts
methods.description: Reads partition data from files into memory.

methods.name: layoutPartitions
methods.description: Calculates offsets and sizes for partitions within firmware space based on constraints.

methods.name: buildPartitionTable
methods.description: Builds the binary partition table to embed within firmware image.

methods.name: writeOutFirmware
methods.description: Constructs and writes the complete firmware binary image from partition data.
